synthesizedFacts.fact: Exfoliation is the process of removing dead skin cells from the outer layer of the skin, which can improve skin appearance but may cause irritation if not done properly.
There are two main methods of exfoliation: mechanical (physical) and chemical.
Exfoliation can help unclog pores, reduce acne, and improve skin texture, but over-exfoliation can damage the skin barrier.
Exfoliation is not necessary for everyone and should be tailored to individual skin types and conditions.
